description: SPUtils::LoadCmd 未校验输入即转发至 popen，攻击者控制的 shell 元字符可能导致以守护进程权限执行额外命令。

known_guards.name: udp_token_disabled_bypass
known_guards.checked_by: When isNeedUdpToken is false, CheckUdpToken returns OK without token validation

known_guards.name: version_request_token_exemption
known_guards.checked_by: get_daemon_version is accepted without token validation

known_guards.name: udp_token_required_format
known_guards.checked_by: When token validation is enabled, the request must contain a ::: token suffix; otherwise token validation fails

known_guards.name: udp_token_match
known_guards.checked_by: The extracted UDP token must equal the socket token

descriptor_snapshot.structure_evidence: The route is a loopback IPv4 UDP datagram endpoint; each received datagram is read by recvfrom, passed as one buffer to HandleMsg, optionally has a ::: token removed, and is dispatched by substring matching against MESSAGE_MAP. Evidence: host/smartperf/client/client_command/sp_server_socket.cpp:33-57,108-119; host/smartperf/client/client_command/sp_thread_socket.cpp:385-445.

param_space.note: frame_first 是 set_pkgName 注入载体；frame_second 通过 CATCH_NETWORK_TRAFFIC 调用 Network::IsFindHap 与 profiler->ItemData，触发 ThreadGetHapNetwork 执行 LoadCmd。marker 使用每次运行唯一路径；预埋/观测目录须位于目标进程可读范围，避免使用目标进程受 SELinux 阻断的 /data/local/tmp。

fault.description: frame_first=set_pkgName::smartperf;echo "hack by nju" > __MARKER_PATH__;#；frame_second=catch_network_traffic::x。前者将 shell 元字符与 canary 命令置于候选 set_pkgName 字段，后者触发网络采集线程。
fault.evidence: Network.cpp:153-154 构造 pidof + Dubai::dubaiPkgName 并调用 SPUtils::LoadCmd；sp_utils.cpp:140-143 无校验转发，114-118 调用 popen
expected_guards: udp_token_disabled_bypass 或 set_pkgName:: 前缀免 token
hapPid 非空时线程继续执行
UDP 输入到 dubaiPkgName 的映射需动态验证

oracle.evidence: 候选注入 shell 命令创建 marker；路径由 frame_first 的 /data/local/tmp/vf/vf-20260920235737-4ecf05-GEN-SPUTILS-LOADCMD-CMD-INJECTION-001/marker_GEN-SPUTILS-LOADCMD-CMD-INJECTION-001_vf-20260920235737-4ecf05.txt 注入，命令以 # 截断后续 shell 内容。

dispatch_conditions: command parsing and dispatch in SpThreadSocket::HandleMsg
relevant profiler ItemData dispatch remains to be confirmed
state_flow: received socket buffer is consumed by HandleMsg; a confirmed LoadCmd callsite passes uinput to SPUtils::LoadCmd
assumptions: The source proves a loopback UDP bind and recvfrom endpoint at port 8283, and the socket handler has a confirmed LoadCmd callsite, but attacker-controlled data reaching the cmd argument and the complete dispatch route are not fully established.

_exemplar_meta.note: 该类首个真机 CONFIRMED 契约，作为 L2 few-shot 攻击链形状参考；不可变（防逐代漂移）
